svg.text: Why Tag Reuse is Catastrophic -- one byte sequence, two interpretations

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: The same message in Kafka is read by schema v1 as $50 USD. Six months later, schema v2 reuses the same tag for a

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: different field. Replay corrupts everything downstream.

svg.text: The wire format has no way to know which schema produced the bytes. Tag numbers are the only contract -- reuse one

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: and old messages decode as the new type, silently.
